title: CrashGuard: evaluation, benchmark and audit software for ESP32 crash detection and LoRa alerting
description: Software and data-science part of CrashGuard (B.Tech project, SRIHER). Code is Apache-2.0. Artefacts derived from the VZCrash dataset (surrogate-generator parameters, audit lists) are CC BY-NC 4.0 with attribution to the VZCrash authors; raw third-party data are not included. Hardware results are not part of this release.
notes: No DOI is claimed in the repository; Zenodo issues one on release. VZCrash-derived files in release/ carry CC BY-NC 4.0.
